instruction: Configure Visual Studio Code to automatically start the Jupyter server when opening Jupyter notebooks.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling automatic trust for Jupyter notebooks by setting jupyter.alwaysTrustNotebooks to true. Similar single-setting modification pattern as original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical semantic mismatch: Instruction asks to 'automatically start the Jupyter server when opening Jupyter notebooks', but evaluator checks for 'jupyter.alwaysTrustNotebooks' setting
The setting 'jupyter.alwaysTrustNotebooks' controls whether to trust notebooks without prompting (a security feature), NOT whether to automatically start the Jupyter server
Wrong setting verified: The evaluator checks for a completely different feature than what the instruction requires
Expected value is semantically incorrect for the stated task goal
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Identify the correct VSCode setting that controls automatic Jupyter server startup (e.g., settings related to kernel auto-start or server launch behavior)
Update the expected value to check for the correct setting key-value pair
Alternatively, update the instruction to match what the evaluator actually verifies: 'Configure Visual Studio Code to always trust Jupyter notebooks without prompting'
